terra.problem: The passage does not say Xerxes had a whole library to choose from.
The record says Mordecai exposed the plot, not that he stopped it.
Calling Haman the king’s top official adds a fact from outside the passage without a reference.
The passage says Esther prepared a banquet, but not that she is busy preparing it at this point.
The passage does not say this happens in the middle of the night.
The passage does not say what Haman knew about the reading.
The passage does not say Haman never stopped to ask who else the king could mean.
The passage says the king had ridden the horse, not that it belonged to him.
The passage does not establish who owned the horse or rule out a recent purchase.
The passage does not say Haman wanted a crowd.
Haman cries out the announcement; the passage does not say he reads it.
The passage does not establish that Haman’s arrival or his assumption about the honor happened at the start of the day.
The explanation treats grief as the physical thing covering Haman’s head. The passage describes his head as covered in grief, not what covering he used.
The passage does not establish that these events happened in the morning.
The passage does not say Haman went home looking for support or a pep talk.
